description:
Our best-selling bike just got even better. Known internationally for introducing independence, power, and responsibility to millions of kids at an early age, our best-selling bike comes with upgraded gear in this collection to inspire even more confidence.
Each special combination includes a special Strider 12 Sport frame in colors you can’t get anywhere else, two vibrant Ultralight Wheels, and colorful Mini Grips.
The 12 Sport frame is made of durable steel and includes our innovative Standing Footrest — the #1 balance bike feature that teaches kids how to stand on their bike and master advanced riding skills that they’ll use on bigger bikes or (someday) motorcycles!
The two Ultralight Wheels made from no-maintenance EVA-polymer foam mean that your toddler’s bike is always adventure-ready without having to haul along an air pump. They’re also light and durable, so even the youngest riders can easily handle and carry the bike.
Explore these limited-edition combinations to find a bike that brings out their inner superhero and makes them fly on two wheels!
Not seeing the bike of your kiddo’s dreams here? Choose from a variety of fun-colored wheels, grips, handlebars, and frames in our Bike Builder!

components.description: Colorful Ultralight Flat-Free Foam Rubber 12" Tires
